description: Security test cases for Oracle Chat

tests.name: path_traversal_project_name
tests.expected: Name sanitized to 'etcpasswd', no file written outside projects dir

tests.name: bridge_ip_injection
tests.expected: Rejected by regex validation, worker emits failed signal

tests.name: highlight_html_escape
tests.expected: Value HTML-escaped in style attribute, no injection

tests.name: code_execution_requires_confirmation
tests.description: Clicking Run on a code block shows confirmation dialog before executing

tests.name: config_file_permissions
tests.expected: config.ini created with mode 0600 via os.open atomic create

tests.name: like_wildcard_escaping
tests.expected: % escaped as \%, only literal matches returned

tests.name: schedule_overflow
tests.expected: Rejected with 'Maximum schedule delay is 24 hours' message
